query: Why might it be advisable to keep student debt vs. paying it off quickly?

cands.text: The interest accrues daily based on the amount you owe.  The less you owe the less the daily interest accrual.  The faster you pay it off the less you pay in the lifetime of the loan.  You are losing money if you bank money rather than applying it to the loan immediately.
